description: This PHP class `EndpointRule` is part of the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically managing rules for endpoint resolution within the AWS EndpointV2 Ruleset framework. It handles condition evaluation, endpoint resolution, property and header resolution for endpoint definitions based on input parameters and a standard library.

classes.name: EndpointRule
classes.description: Represents a rule for resolving an AWS service endpoint based on conditions, properties, and headers within the EndpointV2 ruleset framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EndpointRule with a definition array, storing the endpoint configuration.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the stored endpoint configuration array.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates whether the rule conditions are met based on input parameters and, if so, resolves and returns the endpoint.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves an endpoint URI, properties, and headers based on input parameters and the standard library.

methods.name: resolveProperties
methods.description: Recursively resolves properties of the endpoint, handling templates.

methods.name: resolveHeaders
methods.description: Resolves headers for the endpoint, resolving template strings within header values.
